posts.text: I just don’t really get it. SGA is great statistically and they’re winning too but when the consensus is that teams have to change the way they run their offense just bc you’re standing on the court… AND everyone agrees you’re the most impactful player… how’s that not MVP

He’s right. If the most dominant defensive season anyone has ever seen since… Bill Russell? and taking a team to this many wins doesn’t win the MVP, you’re saying something about defense, in general.


Anthony Slater (@anthonyVslater)

Draymond Green on Victor Wembanyama vocalizing his MVP case: “I hated it…and I absolutely loved it.”

Green has been vocal in the past on DPOY: “You don’t help them see it, damnit they can’t see.”
